evidence: Page 2, Section 1 ('本報告回答什麼問題') & Table ('要求、正文證據與解讀界線'): Explicitly frames the interview requirement from official checklist page 3 ('針對需求單位進行訪談並留有紀錄與統計分析') with exact evidence mapping.
Page 3, Section 2 ('資料設計與判定規則') & Table ('樣本與有效性規則'): Defines response denominator (10 received), completion criteria, and exclusion rules prior to analysis.
Page 4, Section 3 ('訪談執行步驟'): Sets a 7-step standard operating procedure for authorization, informed consent, de-identification, structured recording, read-back verification, and data locking.
Pages 4-5, Section 4 ('完整訪談題綱與填答欄位'): Contains 10 operational interview questions (Q1-Q10) with exact wording, response anchors (1 to 5 Likert scale), and read-back confirmation.
Pages 5-6, Section 5 ('合成樣本登錄與納入排除') & Table ('收到回覆逐筆狀態'): Logs all 10 responses (S01-S10) with 8 eligible and 2 excluded (S09 refused consent; S10 missing 3 score fields).

Pages 6-10, Section 6 ('八份完整合成訪談紀錄'): Provides 8 complete individual interview record cards (S01-S08) detailing date, role, Q2 top 3 priorities, Q3 urgency, Q4 six ratings, Q5 concrete change, Q6 schedule/mode, Q7 fee, Q8 barrier, Q9 privacy boundary, and Q10 verification.
Page 11, Section 7 ('完整需求評分資料與欄位字典') & Table ('六項能力需求分數矩陣'): Full 8 x 6 = 48 rating matrix with column sums, row sums, and field dictionary.
Pages 12-13, Section 8 ('統計結果與逐步計算'): Contains statistical ranking table ('需求排序與指標'), manual formula calculations, and explicit 3-tier tie-breaking rules.
Pages 13-14, Section 9 ('角色差異、時段偏好與參與障礙'): Subgroup comparisons (frontline vs admin, n=4 each), condition distribution, and coded barrier frequency table.
Pages 14-15, Section 10 ('發現、證據強度與可執行建議'): 4 data-backed findings, evidence boundary disclaimers, and 6-item actionable recommendation tracking table.
Pages 15-17, Section 11 & Appendices: Official requirement traceability index, 6-step authentic replacement procedure, audit checklist, and title-blind validation guidelines.
